summary: Preinstall dropper fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style identifiers (`_0xNNNN`) and per-callsite string-scramble maps, and at install time downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727 KB Bun-compiled CJS bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) with all logic packed into a scrambled 4000+ entry string array and reconstructed via a decoder — an opaque payload. The package advertises itself as an ESLint plugin (author `ServiceTitan`, homepage `github.com/servicetitan/folder-lint`) but ships a TODO placeholder README and no ESLint plugin code; the ESLint-tooling identity is a cover story. Fetching an alternate language runtime to execute a bundled obfuscated payload at install has no relation to the advertised purpose and grants arbitrary code execution on the installer's host on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
